select a.id, a.application_round, a.topic_id, a.chapter_id, a.merchant_id, a.status, a.source, a.replacement_of_offer_id, a.message, a.audit_remark, a.audit_member_id, a.handle_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, t.name as topic_name, t.img_url as topic_img_url, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.circle_theme_code, c.name as chapter_name, m.name as merchant_name, o.id as offer_id, o.withdraw_reason as offer_withdraw_reason, p.checked_at as circle_supply_checked_at, case when o.id is not null and o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now()) then 1 else 0 end as offer_active, case when o.id is null then 'NONE' when o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now()) then 'ACTIVE' when o.status = 0 and nullif(trim(o.withdraw_reason), '') is not null then 'WITHDRAWN' when o.status = 0 then 'INACTIVE' else 'EXPIRED' end as offer_state from merchant_chapter_application a left join cms_topic t on t.id = a.topic_id left join cms_topic_chapter c on c.id = a.chapter_id left join mms_merchant m on m.member_id = a.merchant_id and m.del_flag = 0 left join merchant_chapter_offer o on o.chapter_id = a.chapter_id and o.merchant_id = a.merchant_id left join merchant_circle_supply_profile p on p.offer_id = o.id and p.is_current = 1 where a.topic_id = #{topicId} and (a.del_flag = 0 or (a.del_flag = 2 and o.status = 0 and nullif(trim(o.withdraw_reason), '') is not null)) order by a.create_time desc
